platforms.name: WREK Digital Email and Physical Music Submission
platforms.country: United States / Atlanta, Georgia student-run freeform radio with worldwide online listening
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; optional physical media, packaging and international postage are sender-funded.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WREK authorizes either email to its published Music Director address or physical mail, while noting that CDs and LPs have a better chance of airplay and that receipt is not acknowledged. A human must choose the delivery method, confirm format and rights, prepare a tailored pitch or physical package, verify the current postal details, and approve the final email or shipment.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from WREK first-party Music, submission and homepage pages. The official route publishes music.director@wrek.org and the postal address WREK 91.1 FM, 350 Ferst Drive, Georgia Tech, John Lewis Student Center, Suite 2140, Atlanta, GA 30332. WREK accepts common music-media formats, says CDs and LPs have a better chance of airplay, does not acknowledge receipt because of volume, and confirms rotation by automated weekly email when an address is supplied. Independent music is explicitly eligible. Current activity was confirmed through 24/7 broadcasting, online listening, a current schedule and playlist posts dated through 2026-07-10. The business email was verified as plaintext, purpose-specific and published on the official submission page; no SMTP, MX, catch-all or mailbox-level probe was performed. No email, package or submission was prepared or sent.

platforms.name: KALX Physical CD and Vinyl Airplay Submission
platforms.country: United States / Berkeley, California freeform university radio with worldwide streaming
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; professionally pressed media, packaging and international postage are sender-funded.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KALX currently accepts only physical, professionally pressed CDs or LPs and explicitly rejects downloads, file transfers, streaming links, videos, burned CD-Rs and other digital forms. A human must confirm that eligible pressed media exists, select the release, verify the current Music Director address, prepare the package, and approve production and postage costs before shipment.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from KALX first-party Contact, FAQ and homepage pages. The official physical route is KALX, Attn: Music Director, University of California, 26 Social Sciences Building #5650, Berkeley, CA 94720-5650. The page publishes music@kalx.berkeley.edu for the Music Directors, but the airplay rule directly below it says music submissions are physical-only; the address was therefore verified as a business contact and not queued as a digital submission inbox. General management and mail addresses explicitly reject music submissions. Current operation was confirmed through a live playlist, a current daily schedule, a coming attraction dated 2026-07-17 and 2026 specialty-chart content. No email, physical media, package or shipment was prepared.

platforms.name: CJSW Full-Release Digital Upload Form
platforms.country: Canada / Calgary, Alberta campus and community radio with worldwide online listening
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or mandatory payment is stated.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CJSW accepts only digital EPs or albums released within the last three months, containing at least three unique tracks, supplied as MP3 files in one ZIP; singles are excluded. The external Jotform requires release metadata, website or streaming URL, bio, RIYL, ZIP upload, artwork, sharing and permanent-library permission, and contains a honeypot-style empty field. A human must verify eligibility and rights, prepare files, review the consent, avoid the protected field, and submit manually without automating the form.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from CJSW's first-party Music Submissions page, the officially linked 2026 Jotform, Contact page and homepage. Required form data includes email, artist and release names, label or self-released status, EP/full-length status, official release date, genre and subgenre, website or streaming URL, location, short bio or release description, RIYL, a full MP3-only ZIP, album artwork and permission to share the release with programmers and permanently add it to CJSW's digital library. A one-sheet PDF is optional. Calgary-area artists may separately opt into a signed campus-station mailout; that local-only option is not applicable automatically. The form exposes a 'Should be Empty' anti-spam field, so no automated interaction is allowed. A Music & Performance Director assistance address is protected in first-party extraction and was not decoded or guessed. Current activity was confirmed through live programming, an active schedule and 2026 editorial posts. No form field, upload, signature, consent or submission was completed.
